title: Birdeye vs Podium: which platform wins in 2026? | Pabau

facts.fact: Neither Birdeye nor Podium publishes a rate card, so both quote prices by location count and feature tier, according to the Pabau blog.
facts.quote: Neither vendor publishes a rate card, so both quote by location count and feature tier.

facts.fact: The page lists Birdeye's starting price as quote-based, not a fixed published amount.
facts.quote: | Birdeye | Multi-location enterprises | Review monitoring across 200+ sites | Quote-based | 4.7/5 (657) |

facts.fact: The page lists Podium's starting price as quote-based, not a fixed published amount.
facts.quote: | Podium | Local service businesses | SMS-first review collection and lead conversion | Quote-based | 4.3/5 (477) |

facts.fact: The page lists Pabau's starting price as $62 per month.
facts.quote: Pabau | Healthcare and wellness practices | Reputation management built into clinical workflows | From $62/month

facts.fact: According to the page, Birdeye monitors reviews across more than 200 sites.
facts.quote: Birdeye monitors reviews across more than 200 sites, and Podium concentrates on Google and Facebook.

facts.fact: Per Capterra as cited on the page, Birdeye holds a 4.7/5 rating from 657 verified reviews.
facts.quote: Birdeye holds a 4.7/5 rating from 657 verified reviews.

facts.fact: Per Capterra as cited on the page, Podium holds a 4.3/5 rating from 477 reviews.
facts.quote: Capterra reviewers give Podium a 4.3/5 rating from 477 reviews

facts.fact: The page's comparison table gives Pabau a rating of 4.7/5 based on 600+ reviews, with no source named in the table.
facts.quote: Pabau | Healthcare and wellness practices | Reputation management built into clinical workflows | From $62/month | 4.7/5 (600+) |

facts.fact: The page states that both Birdeye and Podium need a separate practice management system to trigger a review request after an appointment.
facts.quote: Both need a separate practice management system to trigger a review request after an appointment.

facts.fact: The page states that healthcare and wellness practices can automate review requests inside Pabau, a practice management software.
facts.quote: Healthcare and wellness practices can automate review requests inside practice management software like Pabau.

facts.fact: The page was last updated on September 22, 2026.
